---- MODULE W4Od0m6p1t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Surgeons, Rooms, MaxT, MaxW
ASSUME MaxT \in Nat /\ MaxW \in Nat
Free == "free"
VARIABLES owner, expiry, clock, record, commits, capacity
vars == <<owner, expiry, clock, record, commits, capacity>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Rooms -> Surgeons \cup {Free}]
    /\ expiry \in [Rooms -> 0..MaxT]
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxT
    /\ record \in [Rooms -> 0..MaxW]
    /\ commits \in [Rooms -> 0..MaxW]
    /\ capacity \in 1..MaxW

Init ==
    /\ owner = [r \in Rooms |-> Free]
    /\ expiry = [r \in Rooms |-> 0]
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ record = [r \in Rooms |-> 0]
    /\ commits = [r \in Rooms |-> 0]
    /\ capacity = 1

Valid(r) == owner[r] # Free /\ expiry[r] > clock

Acquire(r, g) ==
    /\ ~Valid(r)
    /\ clock + 1 <= MaxT
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![r] = g]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![r] = clock + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, record, commits, capacity>>

Renew(r) ==
    /\ Valid(r)
    /\ clock + 1 <= MaxT
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![r] = clock + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, clock, record, commits, capacity>>

Write(r) ==
    /\ Valid(r)
    /\ record[r] < MaxW
    /\ record' = [record EXCEPT ![r] = record[r] + 1]
    /\ commits' = [commits EXCEPT ![r] = commits[r] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, expiry, clock, capacity>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxT
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, expiry, record, commits, capacity>>

Reconfig ==
    /\ \E c \in 1..MaxW : capacity' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, expiry, clock, record, commits>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Rooms, g \in Surgeons : Acquire(r, g)
    \/ \E r \in Rooms : Renew(r)
    \/ \E r \in Rooms : Write(r)
    \/ Tick
    \/ Reconfig

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate == \A r \in Rooms : record[r] = commits[r]
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Surgeons = {s1, s2} Rooms = {r1, r2} MaxT = 2 MaxW = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler coordinates several surgeons who compete to edit a shared per-room booking record. Each operating room grants a short-lived lease to at most one surgeon at a time; the lease carries an expiry time measured against a global clock. A surgeon may commit an edit to a room's booking record only while holding an unexpired lease on that room. Every committed edit advances both the room's record and a separate tally of how many commits that room has accepted. As the global clock ticks forward, outstanding leases silently expire, freeing the room for another surgeon to acquire. Hospital administration may reconfigure how many rooms are open for booking while the system runs. Because a surgeon without a valid lease can never write, no two surgeons ever clobber one another's edits and no committed edit is ever dropped.
SAFETY PROPERTY: For every room, the room's booking record equals the count of commits that room has accepted, so no committed update is ever lost.

---- MODULE W4Od15m1p6t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS N, MaxO, MaxW
ASSUME N \in Nat /\ N >= 1
None == 0
Succ(b) == (b % N) + 1
VARIABLES token, writing, orders, waited
vars == <<token, writing, orders, waited>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in 1..N
    /\ writing \in 0..N
    /\ orders \in [1..N -> 0..MaxO]
    /\ waited \in [1..N -> 0..MaxW]

Init ==
    /\ token = 1
    /\ writing = None
    /\ orders = [b \in 1..N |-> 0]
    /\ waited = [b \in 1..N |-> 0]

Enter(b) ==
    /\ writing = None
    /\ token = b
    /\ writing' = b
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, orders, waited>>

Commit(b) ==
    /\ writing = b
    /\ orders[b] < MaxO
    /\ orders' = [orders EXCEPT ![b] = orders[b] + 1]
    /\ writing' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, waited>>

Abort(b) ==
    /\ writing = b
    /\ writing' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, orders, waited>>

Pass ==
    /\ writing = None
    /\ token' = Succ(token)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<writing, orders, waited>>

Wait(b) ==
    /\ b # token
    /\ waited[b] < MaxW
    /\ waited' = [waited EXCEPT ![b] = waited[b] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, writing, orders>>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in 1..N : Enter(b)
    \/ \E b \in 1..N : Commit(b)
    \/ \E b \in 1..N : Abort(b)
    \/ Pass
    \/ \E b \in 1..N : Wait(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoUnauthorizedActor == writing # None => writing = token
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS N = 3 MaxO = 2 MaxW = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoUnauthorizedActor
nl:
A stock exchange runs an opening auction in which several brokers take turns submitting orders around a token ring. The ring holds a single token that rotates from one broker to the next in a fixed cyclic order. A broker may enter the order-entry critical section only when the broker currently holds the token, and while inside it that broker exclusively appends orders to its own tally before leaving. The token only rotates while no broker is inside the critical section. A broker that is merely slow keeps waiting for its turn without ever failing, so the ring never has to route around a dead node. Because entry is gated on holding the token, an unauthorized or stale broker can never be the one performing an order-entry action. The exchange thus guarantees that whoever is actively writing orders is exactly the current token holder.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a broker is inside the order-entry critical section, that broker is the current holder of the ring token, so no unauthorized or stale broker ever acts.

vars == <<holder, deadline, clock, instock, received, dispensed>>

    /\ deadline \in [Types -> 0..MaxT]
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxT
    /\ instock \in [Types -> 0..MaxU]
    /\ received \in [Types -> 0..MaxU]
    /\ dispensed \in [Types -> 0..MaxU]

Init ==
    /\ holder = [t \in Types |-> Free]
    /\ deadline = [t \in Types |-> 0]
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ instock = [t \in Types |-> 0]
    /\ received = [t \in Types |-> 0]
    /\ dispensed = [t \in Types |-> 0]

Leased(t) == holder[t] # Free /\ deadline[t] > clock

Take(t, g) ==
    /\ ~Leased(t)
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![t] = g]
    /\ deadline' = [deadline EXCEPT ![t] = clock + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, instock, received, dispensed>>

Receive(t) ==
    /\ Leased(t)
    /\ received[t] < MaxU
    /\ instock[t] < MaxU
    /\ received' = [received EXCEPT ![t] = received[t] + 1]
    /\ instock' = [instock EXCEPT ![t] = instock[t] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, deadline, clock, dispensed>>

Dispense(t) ==
    /\ Leased(t)
    /\ instock[t] > 0
    /\ dispensed[t] < MaxU
    /\ instock' = [instock EXCEPT ![t] = instock[t] - 1]
    /\ dispensed' = [dispensed EXCEPT ![t] = dispensed[t] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, deadline, clock, received>>

Expire(t) ==
    /\ holder[t] # Free
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![t] = Free]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<deadline, clock, instock, received, dispensed>>

Crash(g) ==
    /\ \E t \in Types : holder[t] = g
    /\ holder' = [t \in Types |-> IF holder[t] = g THEN Free ELSE holder[t]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<deadline, clock, instock, received, dispensed>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxT
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, deadline, instock, received, dispensed>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Types, g \in Techs : Take(t, g)
    \/ \E t \in Types : Receive(t)
    \/ \E t \in Types : Dispense(t)
    \/ \E t \in Types : Expire(t)
    \/ \E g \in Techs : Crash(g)
    \/ Tick

Conserved == \A t \in Types : instock[t] + dispensed[t] = received[t]
====

CONSTANTS Types = {O, A} Techs = {t1, t2} MaxT = 2 MaxU = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conserved
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker lets technicians take a short lease on a blood type before adjusting its stock. For each blood type the system keeps three counters: total units ever received, units currently in stock, and units already dispensed. A technician may adjust a type only while holding an unexpired lease on it, either recording a newly received unit or dispensing one from stock. A global clock advances and leases expire when the clock passes their deadline, freeing the type for another technician. A technician can crash silently at any moment, which simply abandons whatever lease it held without corrupting any counter. Because every received unit either remains in stock or has been dispensed, and no adjustment can happen without a valid exclusive lease, the running totals can never drift or lose an update. The invariant of interest ties the three counters together for every blood type.
SAFETY PROPERTY: For every blood type, units in stock plus units dispensed equals units ever received, so no received or dispensed update is ever lost.

---- MODULE W4Od19m3p4t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Nodes, Titles, Copies, MaxTerm
None == 0
VARIABLES leader, term, reserved, epoch, beat
vars == <<leader, term, reserved, epoch, beat>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {None}
    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ reserved \in [Titles -> 0..Copies]
    /\ epoch \in [Nodes -> 0..MaxTerm]
    /\ beat \in 0..1

Init ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ term = 0
    /\ reserved = [b \in Titles |-> 0]
    /\ epoch = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]
    /\ beat = 0

Elect(n) ==
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ epoch' = [epoch EXCEPT ![n] = term + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reserved, beat>>

Grant(n, b) ==
    /\ leader = n
    /\ epoch[n] = term
    /\ reserved[b] < Copies
    /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![b] = reserved[b] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, epoch, beat>>

Return(b) ==
    /\ reserved[b] > 0
    /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![b] = reserved[b] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, epoch, beat>>

Failover ==
    /\ leader # None
    /\ leader' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, reserved, epoch, beat>>

Heartbeat ==
    /\ beat' = 1 - beat
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, reserved, epoch>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, b \in Titles : Grant(n, b)
    \/ \E b \in Titles : Return(b)
    \/ Failover
    \/ Heartbeat

WithinCapacity == \A b \in Titles : reserved[b] <= Copies
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Nodes = {n1, n2, n3} Titles = {bk1, bk2} Copies = 2 MaxTerm = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT WithinCapacity
nl:
A library book-reservation service runs on several nodes, only one of which is the elected leader at any time. Two independent service instances draw reservations from one shared pool of physical copies per title. A node becomes leader by winning an election with a strictly higher term than any seen so far, which fences off the previous leader. Only the current leader may grant a reservation, and it grants one for a title only while the number of outstanding reservations for that title is below the number of copies. Patrons may also return a book, decrementing the outstanding count. If the leader fails over, a new election raises the term and a different node takes over granting. Because grants are gated on outstanding reservations staying below the copy count, the pool is never oversubscribed even though two instances share it.
SAFETY PROPERTY: For every title, the number of outstanding reservations never exceeds the number of physical copies of that title.

---- MODULE W4Od3m0p3t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Slots, Engines, MaxV
None == 0
VARIABLES owner, ver, grant, rdslot, rdver
vars == <<owner, ver, grant, rdslot, rdver>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Slots -> {None} \cup Engines]
    /\ ver \in [Slots -> 0..MaxV]
    /\ grant \in [Slots -> 0..1]
    /\ rdslot \in [Engines -> {None} \cup Slots]
    /\ rdver \in [Engines -> 0..MaxV]

Init ==
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> None]
    /\ ver = [s \in Slots |-> 0]
    /\ grant = [s \in Slots |-> 0]
    /\ rdslot = [e \in Engines |-> None]
    /\ rdver = [e \in Engines |-> 0]

Read(e, s) ==
    /\ rdslot' = [rdslot EXCEPT ![e] = s]
    /\ rdver' = [rdver EXCEPT ![e] = ver[s]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, ver, grant>>

Commit(e) ==
    /\ rdslot[e] # None
    /\ LET s == rdslot[e] IN
        /\ owner[s] = None
        /\ ver[s] = rdver[e]
        /\ ver[s] < MaxV
        /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = e]
        /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![s] = ver[s] + 1]
        /\ grant' = [grant EXCEPT ![s] = 1]
    /\ rdslot' = [rdslot EXCEPT ![e] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED rdver

Retry(e) ==
    /\ rdslot[e] # None
    /\ LET s == rdslot[e] IN owner[s] # None \/ ver[s] # rdver[e]
    /\ rdslot' = [rdslot EXCEPT ![e] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, ver, grant, rdver>>

Release(s) ==
    /\ owner[s] # None
    /\ ver[s] < MaxV
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = None]
    /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![s] = ver[s] + 1]
    /\ grant' = [grant EXCEPT ![s] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rdslot, rdver>>

Next ==
    \/ \E e \in Engines, s \in Slots : Read(e, s)
    \/ \E e \in Engines : Commit(e)
    \/ \E e \in Engines : Retry(e)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Release(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleAlloc == \A s \in Slots : grant[s] = (IF owner[s] = None THEN 0 ELSE 1)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Slots = {a, b} Engines = {e1, e2} MaxV = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
nl:
A bank settles interbank transfers in batches, drawing settlement slots from one shared pool that two independent settlement engines both use. To claim a slot an engine first reads the slot's current version, then later commits its claim only if that version is unchanged, using optimistic concurrency with retry on conflict. A successful commit records the engine as the slot's owner and bumps the slot's version. A slot may later be released, clearing its owner and bumping the version again. Each slot carries a grant counter that must reflect exactly whether the slot is currently owned. Because commits are gated on the version match, two engines can never both allocate the same slot, so no slot is ever double-allocated. The bank tracks per-slot ownership and grant accounting to guarantee this.
SAFETY PROPERTY: For every settlement slot, its grant counter is one exactly when the slot has an owner and zero otherwise, so no slot is ever allocated twice.

---- MODULE W4Od9m2p3t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Slots, Feeders, Parts, MaxCap
None == 0
VARIABLES owner, grant, tstate, votes, prop, capacity
vars == <<owner, grant, tstate, votes, prop, capacity>>

Props == [slot : Slots, feeder : Feeders]

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Slots -> {None} \cup Feeders]
    /\ grant \in [Slots -> 0..1]
    /\ tstate \in {"idle", "voting", "committed", "aborted"}
    /\ votes \in [Parts -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]
    /\ prop \in {None} \cup Props
    /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> None]
    /\ grant = [s \in Slots |-> 0]
    /\ tstate = "idle"
    /\ votes = [p \in Parts |-> "none"]
    /\ prop = None
    /\ capacity = MaxCap

Propose(s, f) ==
    /\ tstate = "idle"
    /\ owner[s] = None
    /\ tstate' = "voting"
    /\ prop' = [slot |-> s, feeder |-> f]
    /\ votes' = [p \in Parts |-> "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, grant, capacity>>

CastVote(p, v) ==
    /\ tstate = "voting"
    /\ votes[p] = "none"
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![p] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, grant, tstate, prop, capacity>>

DoCommit ==
    /\ tstate = "voting"
    /\ \A p \in Parts : votes[p] = "yes"
    /\ owner[prop.slot] = None
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![prop.slot] = prop.feeder]
    /\ grant' = [grant EXCEPT ![prop.slot] = 1]
    /\ tstate' = "committed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, prop, capacity>>

DoAbort ==
    /\ tstate = "voting"
    /\ \E p \in Parts : votes[p] = "no"
    /\ tstate' = "aborted"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, grant, votes, prop, capacity>>

Reset ==
    /\ tstate \in {"committed", "aborted"}
    /\ tstate' = "idle"
    /\ prop' = None
    /\ votes' = [p \in Parts |-> "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, grant, capacity>>

Reconfig ==
    /\ \E c \in 0..MaxCap : capacity' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, grant, tstate, votes, prop>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Slots, f \in Feeders : Propose(s, f)
    \/ \E p \in Parts, v \in {"yes", "no"} : CastVote(p, v)
    \/ DoCommit
    \/ DoAbort
    \/ Reset
    \/ Reconfig

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleAllocation == \A s \in Slots : grant[s] = (IF owner[s] = None THEN 0 ELSE 1)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Slots = {s1, s2} Feeders = {f1, f2} Parts = {p1, p2} MaxCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleAllocation
nl:
A power-grid load shedder allocates shed slots to feeders through a two-phase commit across several substation participants. A coordinator proposes allocating a currently-free slot to a feeder, opening a voting round in which every participant casts a yes or no vote. The allocation commits only if all participants vote yes and the slot is still free, recording the feeder as the slot's owner and bumping that slot's grant counter. A no vote aborts the round, and after a commit or abort the coordinator resets to idle. Grid operators may reconfigure the available shedding capacity at runtime. Each slot's grant counter must stay consistent with whether the slot is currently owned. Because commit is gated on the slot being free, no slot is ever allocated to two feeders.
SAFETY PROPERTY: For every shed slot, its grant counter is one exactly when the slot has an owner and zero otherwise, so no slot is ever double-allocated.

---- MODULE W4Od9m5p0t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Ctrl, MaxQ
None == 0
VARIABLES lock, using, votes, candidate, quorum
vars == <<lock, using, votes, candidate, quorum>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ lock \in {None} \cup Ctrl
    /\ using \in [Ctrl -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ votes \in [Ctrl -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ candidate \in {None} \cup Ctrl
    /\ quorum \in 1..MaxQ

Init ==
    /\ lock = None
    /\ using = [c \in Ctrl |-> FALSE]
    /\ votes = [c \in Ctrl |-> FALSE]
    /\ candidate = None
    /\ quorum = MaxQ

Nominate(c) ==
    /\ lock = None
    /\ candidate = None
    /\ candidate' = c
    /\ votes' = [x \in Ctrl |-> FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, using, quorum>>

Vote(v) ==
    /\ candidate # None
    /\ ~votes[v]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![v] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, using, candidate, quorum>>

Grant ==
    /\ candidate # None
    /\ Cardinality({c \in Ctrl : votes[c]}) >= quorum
    /\ lock' = candidate
    /\ candidate' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<using, votes, quorum>>

Enter(c) ==
    /\ lock = c
    /\ ~using[c]
    /\ using' = [using EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, votes, candidate, quorum>>

Leave(c) ==
    /\ using[c]
    /\ using' = [using EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, votes, candidate, quorum>>

Release ==
    /\ lock # None
    /\ \A c \in Ctrl : ~using[c]
    /\ lock' = None
    /\ votes' = [c \in Ctrl |-> FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<using, candidate, quorum>>

Reconfig ==
    /\ \E q \in 1..MaxQ : quorum' = q
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, using, votes, candidate>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Ctrl : Nominate(c)
    \/ \E v \in Ctrl : Vote(v)
    \/ Grant
    \/ \E c \in Ctrl : Enter(c)
    \/ \E c \in Ctrl : Leave(c)
    \/ Release
    \/ Reconfig

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Mutex == \A c \in Ctrl : using[c] => lock = c
====

CONSTANTS Ctrl = {c1, c2, c3} MaxQ = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Mutex
nl:
A power-grid load shedder guards a single critical breaker that at most one controller may operate at a time. To take the breaker lock a candidate controller is nominated, and the other controllers vote; the lock is granted only once the number of yes votes reaches the current quorum threshold. Once granted, the lock holder may enter the operating section, actuate the breaker, and later leave; when no controller is operating the lock can be released. Grid operators may change the quorum threshold at runtime as controllers come and go. A controller is allowed to be operating the breaker only if it is the current lock holder. Because entering the operating section is gated on holding the lock, two controllers never operate the breaker at once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a controller is operating the breaker, it is the current holder of the breaker lock, so the critical breaker is under mutual exclusion.

---- MODULE W4Od19m0p5t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Books, Patrons, MaxV, MaxW
None == 0
VARIABLES phase, ver, done, rdbook, rdver, waited
vars == <<phase, ver, done, rdbook, rdver, waited>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ phase \in [Books -> {"avail", "held", "out"}]
    /\ ver \in [Books -> 0..MaxV]
    /\ done \in [Books -> 0..1]
    /\ rdbook \in [Patrons -> {None} \cup Books]
    /\ rdver \in [Patrons -> 0..MaxV]
    /\ waited \in [Patrons -> 0..MaxW]

Init ==
    /\ phase = [b \in Books |-> "avail"]
    /\ ver = [b \in Books |-> 0]
    /\ done = [b \in Books |-> 0]
    /\ rdbook = [p \in Patrons |-> None]
    /\ rdver = [p \in Patrons |-> 0]
    /\ waited = [p \in Patrons |-> 0]

Read(p, b) ==
    /\ rdbook' = [rdbook EXCEPT ![p] = b]
    /\ rdver' = [rdver EXCEPT ![p] = ver[b]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, ver, done, waited>>

Hold(p) ==
    /\ rdbook[p] # None
    /\ LET b == rdbook[p] IN
        /\ phase[b] = "avail"
        /\ ver[b] = rdver[p]
        /\ ver[b] < MaxV
        /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![b] = "held"]
        /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![b] = ver[b] + 1]
    /\ rdbook' = [rdbook EXCEPT ![p] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<done, rdver, waited>>

Checkout(p) ==
    /\ rdbook[p] # None
    /\ LET b == rdbook[p] IN
        /\ phase[b] = "held"
        /\ ver[b] = rdver[p]
        /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![b] = "out"]
        /\ done' = [done EXCEPT ![b] = 1]
    /\ rdbook' = [rdbook EXCEPT ![p] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, rdver, waited>>

Retry(p) ==
    /\ rdbook[p] # None
    /\ ver[rdbook[p]] # rdver[p]
    /\ rdbook' = [rdbook EXCEPT ![p] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, ver, done, rdver, waited>>

Wait(p) ==
    /\ waited[p] < MaxW
    /\ waited' = [waited EXCEPT ![p] = waited[p] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, ver, done, rdbook, rdver>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Patrons, b \in Books : Read(p, b)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : Hold(p)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : Checkout(p)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : Retry(p)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : Wait(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AtMostOnce == \A b \in Books : done[b] = (IF phase[b] = "out" THEN 1 ELSE 0)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS Books = {bk1, bk2} Patrons = {p1, p2} MaxV = 3 MaxW = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AtMostOnce
nl:
A library reservation system lets patrons place a hold on a book and then perform a checkout, which is an irreversible action. Each patron works optimistically: it first reads a book's version, then acts only if the version is still unchanged, retrying otherwise. Placing a hold moves a book from available to held and bumps its version; a checkout moves a held book to the terminal checked-out state. Once a book is checked out there is no action that returns it, so the irreversible checkout can occur at most once per book. A patron that is merely slow keeps waiting without ever failing. Each book carries a done flag that must be one exactly when the book is in the checked-out state.     /\ grant = [s \in Slots |-> 0]
    /\ capacity = 1

Allocate(k, s) ==
    /\ token = k
    /\ owner[s] = None
    /\ s <= capacity
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = k]
    /\ grant' = [grant EXCEPT ![s] = 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, capacity>>

Release(s) ==
    /\ owner[s] # None
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = None]
    /\ grant' = [grant EXCEPT ![s] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, capacity>>

Pass ==
    /\ token' = Succ(token)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, grant, capacity>>

Reconfig ==
    /\ \E c \in 1..NS : capacity' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, owner, grant>>

Next ==
    \/ \E k \in 1..NC, s \in Slots : Allocate(k, s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Release(s)
    \/ Pass
    \/ Reconfig

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleAllocation == \A s \in Slots : grant[s] = (IF owner[s] = None THEN 0 ELSE 1)
====

nl:
A container-ship crane yard assigns containers to stack slots under a rotating token ring of cranes. A single token circulates cyclically among the cranes, and only the crane currently holding the token may allocate a container to a slot. A slot may be allocated only if it is currently free and its index is within the yard's active capacity, which the harbor master may change at runtime. Allocating records the holding crane as the slot's owner and sets that slot's grant flag; a container may later be released, clearing the owner and the flag. Each slot's grant flag must be one exactly when the slot has an owner. Because allocation is guarded on the slot being free, no stack slot is ever allocated to two containers.
SAFETY PROPERTY: For every stack slot, its grant flag is one exactly when the slot has an owner, so no slot is ever double-allocated.
